answer: To forge 1,000 identities I must lock 240 units each, 240,000 for 15 epochs. Any rival can challenge within 3 epochs; 9 jurors rule within 2, and proven forgery slashes 80%, 25% to the challenger. The river never dries: at 30% caught, my batch loses 57,600 units while challengers pocket 14,400. Honest work releases 20 units per clean epoch; the juniper of my fakes earns nothing while locked, and a walnut of patience cannot move frozen capital.
